Publication of Annual Report and Accounts
Fletcher King plc (the "Company") announces that it has posted its Annual Report and Accounts and a Notice of Annual General Meeting (“AGM”) to shareholders today.
The Annual Report and Accounts and Notice of AGM are available to view on the Company's website:  www.fletcherking.co.uk.
Liam Murray / Jo Turner / Edward Downes
